title: Handwritten core + AI-assisted dev: my browser MMORTS on top of an economic sim, a few months in (open playtest)
author: MerchantKings
selftext:
"Solo dev here. Merchant Kings of Africa is a browser MMORTS that sits on top of an economic simulation, set in the trading empires of historical Africa: towns, armies, caravan trade routes, a market you can hoard to hurt your rivals, and two modes (Finale: first to 1,000 points; Crown: endless king of the hill).

**How I used AI:**

- I started from an old codebase I wrote by hand that already had web multiplayer support and a sprite engine.
- I used AI to help edit that codebase.
- I also used AI to help with art creation.

A few months in, it's on ruleset 48 and in its 3rd or 4th big playtest. The main feedback so far is about the game communicating back to the player, so I'm opening the test up.

**Play free in your browser (desktop or mobile):** [merchantkingsofafrica.com](https://www.merchantkingsofafrica.com/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=reddit_playtest_nov2026&utm_content=aigamedev) - free account, about a minute to found your kingdom.

Happy to answer workflow questions in the comments :)"

comments.author: teapot_RGB_color
comments.body:
Yes, it doesn't look very appealing to me. Like, it's it fun? That would be first question.

Second is, what is the unique selling point.

Having to create an account to play is too much friction unless you can sell me on the first two points

replies.author: MerchantKings
replies.body: So the unique selling point would be the economic simulation underneath. Think you have reign over a certain area of land that has X resources. Those resources are much more rare in other parts of the world so you have something others dont. You can trade it on the market or starve out your competition. As for the creating an account to play as friction... this is not the first time I have heard that ugh I am starting to think about the ability to create a guest account. I would worry about players abusing that though.

replies.author: MerchantKings
replies.body: Also thank you for your feedback :)

replies.author: Tommyruin
replies.body: What's there to abuse on free to play?

replies.author: MerchantKings
replies.body: So creating several Guest accounts and working them in such a way to take over a server. Or manipulate the game in a way that a user with one account wouldn't. Clearly anyone can sign up for a bunch of email address to do the same, something I can't stop but its to give them a bit of pause is all.

replies.author: MerchantKings
replies.body: Hey u/teapot_RGB_color to follow up I have now created a Guest account system. No more creating an account! If you get a chance check it out!
